guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: MBBR以移動載體提供附著生物膜表面，水流、載體混合與供氧共同影響反應。學徒區分名目填充比例、受保護面積、實際活性與攔網通水。
guides.conceptEn: MBBR uses moving carriers for attached biofilm; flow, carrier mixing and oxygen jointly affect reaction. Distinguish fill fraction, protected area, actual activity and retaining-screen hydraulics.
procedure: 先點選「可生物降解進料」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把流量改成1500 m³/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 270 kg/d。與基準 216 kg/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「移動床有效反應容積」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把有效容積改成600 m³，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 6 h。與基準 8 h比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「載體受保護面積」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把填充f降成0.40，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 16000 m²。與基準 20000 m²比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「單位附著面積負荷」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把有機負荷改成90 kg/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 4.5 g/(m²·d)。與基準 3 g/(m²·d)比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「膜厚與傳質路徑」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把膜厚減成0.00025 m，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 62.5 s。與基準 250 s比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「混合與需氧分辨」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把供氧效率降成1.2 kg O₂/kWh，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 16.66667 kW。與基準 13.33333 kW比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「載體出口攔網」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把堵塞分率增加到0.50，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 0.5 m²。與基準 0.8 m²比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「硝化生物膜需氧」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把氨氮量改成40 kg N/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 182.8 kg O₂/d。與基準 137.1 kg O₂/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「水相轉化與脫落固體」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把出水改成60 mg/L，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 70 %。與基準 80 %比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「後段固液分離」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把面積加至400 m²，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 15 m/d。與基準 20 m/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
procedureEn: Select the biodegradable feed measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only flow to1500 m³/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 270 kg/d. Compare with baseline 216 kg/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the moving-bed effective volume measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only effective volume to600 m³ with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 6 h. Compare with baseline 8 h and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the protected carrier area measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only fillf to0.40 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 16000 m². Compare with baseline 20000 m² and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the attached-area loading measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only organic load to90 kg/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 4.5 g/(m²·d). Compare with baseline 3 g/(m²·d) and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the film thickness/transport path measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only film thickness to0.00025 m with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 62.5 s. Compare with baseline 250 s and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the mixing/oxygen distinction measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only transfer efficiency to1.2 kg O₂/kWh with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 16.66667 kW. Compare with baseline 13.33333 kW and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the carrier-retaining outlet screen measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only blockage to0.50 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 0.5 m². Compare with baseline 0.8 m² and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the nitrifying-film oxygen measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only ammonia load to40 kg N/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 182.8 kg O₂/d. Compare with baseline 137.1 kg O₂/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the conversion/detached solids measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only effluent to60 mg/L with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 70 %. Compare with baseline 80 % and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the downstream solids separation measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only area to400 m² with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 15 m/d. Compare with baseline 20 m/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.
evidence: 將同一總時窗切成三段，以各段平均流率 Qi（m³/d）、濃度 Ci（mg/L）與時長 Δti（d）算質量 Mi=QiCiΔti/1000（kg）；加總質量後除以總時長，得到平均負荷率（kg/d），再與相同總時窗的流量加權混合樣比對。在離線場景為「可生物降解進料」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
用示蹤突破曲線比較平均停留與最早突破，保留流量紀錄。在離線場景為「移動床有效反應容積」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
依載體資料確認面積定義，盤點裝填量並觀察是否均勻翻動。在離線場景為「載體受保護面積」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
量測進出水負荷並將其與載體面積和水溫一起報告。在離線場景為「單位附著面積負荷」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
比較膜厚、溶氧剖面與表面負荷，不能僅稱量載體。在離線場景為「膜厚與傳質路徑」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
把溶氧、尾氣與電表同步；用一段變負載試驗比較回應。在離線場景為「混合與需氧分辨」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
核對上下游水位與流量，拍攝堵塞範圍並觀察載體流失。在離線場景為「載體出口攔網」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
用氨、亞硝酸與硝酸三者的氮收支核對，不只看溶氧。在離線場景為「硝化生物膜需氧」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
同時量測污泥固體量與水相濃度，對照移除質量。在離線場景為「水相轉化與脫落固體」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
用沉降柱與進出水SS比對捕集，不把水清澈當溶解物已去除。在離線場景為「後段固液分離」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
evidenceEn: Split the same total sampling window into three intervals. For each interval use mean flow Qi (m³/d), concentration Ci (mg/L) and duration Δti (d) to calculate mass Mi=QiCiΔti/1000 (kg). Sum the masses and divide by total duration to obtain mean loading (kg/d), then compare with a flow-weighted composite covering that same total window. Build an offline evidence table for biodegradable feed; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Compare tracer mean residence and early breakthrough while retaining flow records. Build an offline evidence table for moving-bed effective volume; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Check the area definition in carrier data, inventory media and observe uniform movement. Build an offline evidence table for protected carrier area; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Measure influent/effluent loads and report them alongside carrier area and water temperature. Build an offline evidence table for attached-area loading; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Compare thickness, oxygen profiles and surface loading rather than carrier mass alone. Build an offline evidence table for film thickness/transport path; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Synchronize DO, off-gas and power data and compare responses during a changing-load trial. Build an offline evidence table for mixing/oxygen distinction; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Check upstream/downstream levels and flow, document blockage and observe media loss. Build an offline evidence table for carrier-retaining outlet screen; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Check a nitrogen balance using ammonia, nitrite and nitrate rather than DO alone. Build an offline evidence table for nitrifying-film oxygen; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Measure sludge solids and water concentrations together to reconcile removed mass. Build an offline evidence table for conversion/detached solids; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Compare a settling-column test and inlet/outlet SS; clear water does not prove dissolved contaminants were removed. Build an offline evidence table for downstream solids separation; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
pitfalls: 等時間採樣遇到尖峰流量會低估負荷，先檢查採樣權重。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
隔板破損可能造成短流；擴大容積未必能消除捷徑。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
過高填充可能降低混合並增加攔網負擔。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
外層異營菌搶氧可使同面積硝化能力下降。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
厚膜內層缺氧與脫落會讓出水SS升高。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
散氣器堵塞會提高壓力而降低氧轉移，風量增加未必有效。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
攔網破損會流失載體，堵塞則可能造成溢流。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
低溫或抑制物可使氨突破，即使供氧功率正常。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
以清水稀釋取代處理會讓濃度變低但不一定減少排放質量。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
排泥不良會讓泥層抬升，造成出水固體增加。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
pitfallsEn: Equal-time sampling during a flow peak can understate loading; inspect sampling weights first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
A broken baffle may create short-circuiting; a larger volume need not remove the shortcut. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Excess fill can reduce mixing and overload retention screens. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Outer heterotrophs can consume oxygen and reduce nitrification at the same area. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Oxygen-poor thick inner layers and sloughing can raise effluent SS. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Clogged diffusers can raise pressure while reducing transfer, so more airflow may be ineffective. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
A damaged screen loses carriers while blockage can cause overflow. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Cold conditions or inhibitors can cause ammonia breakthrough despite normal aeration power. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Dilution can lower concentration without lowering discharge mass. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Poor sludge withdrawal raises the sludge blanket and increases effluent solids. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.

courses.summaryEn: AnoxKaldnes documents moving-carrier biofilm reactors, with EPA information providing treatment context; manufacturer surface area is not treated as guaranteed removal. The map marks the EPA headquarters area as a method-source institution, not a treatment plant for this lesson.

history.title: 移動床生物膜反應器
history.text: AnoxKaldnes技術資料介紹移動載體生物膜反應器，EPA技術資料提供污水處理比較背景；本課不把廠商面積值視為保證去除率。地圖僅標示方法資料來源機構EPA總部的區域參考點，不表示此處設有本課處理廠。
history.textEn: AnoxKaldnes documents moving-carrier biofilm reactors, with EPA information providing treatment context; manufacturer surface area is not treated as guaranteed removal. The map marks the EPA headquarters area as a method-source institution, not a treatment plant for this lesson.

courses.connection: MBBR以移動載體提供附著生物膜表面，水流、載體混合與供氧共同影響反應。學徒區分名目填充比例、受保護面積、實際活性與攔網通水。
courses.connectionEn: MBBR uses moving carriers for attached biofilm; flow, carrier mixing and oxygen jointly affect reaction. Distinguish fill fraction, protected area, actual activity and retaining-screen hydraulics.
